svt_mipi_dsi_device_agent Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_device_agent:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Defines DSI Device agent with basic UVM components to receive data from Host and also drives response data.

DSI Device agent contains Active and Passive components. DSI Device Driver is an active component and Monitor is passive component. Active components can be disabled.

DSI Driver receives data from the interface and form the packet and sends response packet if needed. Monitor is used to sample interface signals.

Also, defines analysis ports to get received packet from Monitor and DSI Driver.
